card.title: The Object Changes Meaning
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary detail and reinterpret it as gift, threat, evidence, or symbol as the scene evolves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep this old ticket. It proves we went somewhere together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It proves you booked us different trains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's evidence of a mistake we survived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put them together. Now they're an invitation to get it right.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 ticket proves togetherness, A3 wrong trains become survived error and A5 both retained tickets become a future invitation.

relationship.evidence: B2 recalls a real mistake and B4 reveals their own preservation, adding emotional reciprocity.

heightening.evidence: B4 kept ticket turns A5 solitary evidence into a shared reason to try again.
